correctness.rationale: The given matrices are signed monomial. Direct row tracking identifies each coordinate stretch as 2 raised to its residue-chain visit count. The right-branch symbols are iid Bernoulli(1/2) by the primary paper, so the residue chain is P=(I+shift)/2. For each zero-mean linear coordinate contrast, g(r)-g(r+1)=2f(r) solves (I-P)g=f. Its martingale differences are exactly ±f(r), giving the full quadratic-variation limit (1/M)sum f(r)^2 by finite-state ergodicity. Bounded martingale CLT plus Cramer-Wold proves the singular Gaussian covariance. Continuous mapping and L2 boundedness yield condition-number law and expectation. 2550 signed-derivative word checks and 984 exact rational Poisson/variance tests passed; these supplement the general proof.

value.rationale: The twisted baker model was introduced to probe how twisting and stretching combine; its known nonuniform periodic expansion leaves typical derivative isotropy unresolved. A complete Gaussian fluctuation covariance with only one zero direction, an exact singular-value condition-number distribution and its sharp mean growth coefficient show that all Lyapunov exponents are equal while logarithmic directional anisotropy persists at order sqrt(n). This is a natural statistical invariant and quantitatively relevant to finite-time sensitivity, beyond a renaming or one-case computation.
